name: @savvifi/meridian-mui-kit
//packageManager: PINNED, and load-bearing. corepack with no pin installs whatever pnpm is
newest, and pnpm 11 NO LONGER READS the `pnpm` field in package.json — it
warns that `pnpm.overrides` were ignored and carries on. Those overrides are
what keeps ONE copy of @savvifi/meridian-proto-ts in this tree; protobuf-es
types are nominal, so two copies make two PanelDescriptors mutually
unassignable and nothing typechecks. A drifting toolchain would switch that
MIGRATING TO pnpm 11: move `pnpm.overrides` into pnpm-workspace.yaml FIRST
and verify the build still resolves a single proto-ts.
description: The MUI ComponentKit for the meridian React renderer — paints meridian.ui.v1 PanelDescriptors / ViewDescriptors with MUI (its own table + form components, with CLIENT/OFFSET/CURSOR pagination) over the meridian-web-react WebRenderer seam. Standalone — no @aion/ui dependency.
